title: The search for the correlate of consciousness looked in the wrong place

statements.text: Taking vision as the model of consciousness, as the search for its neural correlate did, led astray, because the consciousness of cortical images is derivative. Research would have done better to start from the brain mechanisms of basic feelings, such as hunger or thermoregulation, which usually involve no exteroceptive images at all.

sources.quote: may therefore have led us astray, because their consciousness is derivative
It seems the conceivability argument only arose in the first place because we were looking for the NCC in the wrong place.
